resources.string: Let\'s go
Call the people you keep meaning to call.
Not every contact is a friend. You choose who matters.
One name at a time, with enough context to say yes.
Everything stays on your phone: no cloud, no tracking.
Skip for now?

Go back
Without contacts access, Orbit can\'t build your lists from your phone book.
Without call log access, Orbit can\'t notice when you\'ve already called someone, so the same person may keep coming up.
Without notifications, Orbit won\'t be able to nudge you when it\'s time to reach out.
Allow access
Continue without it

Allowed

Stays on your device
Build lists from your people
Orbit reads your phone contacts so you can pick who goes on each list by name.
We don\'t upload your address book.
You can still create lists. To add people, allow access in your phone\'s settings.
Read your call history
Orbit looks at when you last called or were called by each person, so it knows who\'s been quiet.
Read-only: Orbit can\'t make calls or change your call history.
You can still create lists. To use call history, allow access in your phone\'s settings.
Stay in the loop
Orbit can let you know when it\'s time to reach out to someone.
Quiet by design
One quiet nudge per list per day. You can change this any time.
You can still use Orbit. To get nudges, allow notifications in your phone\'s settings.
